name: Face Mist Botanical Essence
description: Beute Pro Botanical Essence Face Mist is full of anti-bacterial & anti-inflammatory properties, making this mist perfect for those with acne prone skin.
ingredients: Aloe Vera Extract (Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract)
Pure Lemon & Mint Extracts (Citrus Limon & Mentha Extracts)
Pure Cucumber Extract (Cucumis Sativus Fruit Extract)
Tea Tree Oil (Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Oil)
benefits: Balances and hydrates mature, dehydrated & dry skin
Soothes and nourishes depleted or irritated skin
usage: Spray 2-3 times evenly across the face and neck can be used anytime during the day to refresh and moisturize the skin. Can be used for instant hydration, as a toner, before makeup as a primer, other application of makeup to set it.
notes: New product, not previously in products.js. A multi-extract blend combining several of the other mist ingredients.
